# Fujian Xiahua Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd.

Premium B2B manufacturing independent site for high-performance ABS faucet handles, adjustable shower sliders, and precision sanitary brass fittings.

## Corporate Identity
- **Company Name:** Fujian Xiahua Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd. (福建厦华卫浴有限公司)
- **HQ Address:** Plumbing Manufacturing Zone, Nan'an, Quanzhou, Fujian, China (中国·福建·泉州市南安市水暖工业制造园)
- **Primary Markets:** Southeast Asia, South America, Middle East.
- **Languages Supported:** English (Default), Russian (Русский), Portuguese (Português), Hindi (हिन्दी), Chinese (中文).

## Core Export Product Portfolio
1. **ABS Material Faucet Handles (Model: XH-ABS-101)**
   - High-grade impact-resistant virgin ABS, multilayer electroplated chrome, compliant with BS EN 200 standard, salt spray tested for over 48 hours.
2. **Xialong Patented High-Grade ABS Electroplated Single-Lever Handle & Accessories (Model: XH-SHSL-202)**
   - Chinese utility model patent ZL 2016 2 0363465.8, high-impact virgin engineering ABS, Class-9 multi-layer mirror electroplated chrome finish, precision internal brass splines, 48h acid salt spray tested.
3. **Patented Quick-Install Shower Bracket Socket (Model: XH-BRFC-303)**
   - National utility model patent ZL 2016 2 0363475.1, quick snap-on mount mechanism for handheld shower heads, dual-tone minimalist design, wear-resistant and anti-slip silicone socket.
4. **Xialong Patented High-Grade ABS Electroplated Single-Lever Handle (Model: XH-ABS-102)**
   - Chinese utility model patent ZL 2016 2 0363475.1, high-impact virgin engineering ABS, Class-9 multi-layer mirror electroplated chrome finish, precision internal brass splines, 48h acid salt spray tested.
5. **Push-Button Adjustable Shower Bar Slider Bracket (Model: XH-71)**
   - One-touch push-button height adjustable shower slider bracket for 18-25mm riser rails, high-grip internal anti-slip pads, 360° swivel cradle, multi-layer mirror chrome finish.
6. **Xialong High-Grade ABS Shower Body Piano Key Button Model (Model: XH-ABSGQ-101)**
   - High-impact virgin engineering ABS, ergonomic piano-key mechanical actuation, anti-scratch gunmetal grey and chrome finishes, tested for 100,000 key-press cycles.

## Quality Certification & Standards
- ISO 9001:2015 Manufacturing Quality Certified.
- WRAS / EN 817 Drinking Water Safety Compliant.
- BS EN 200 / AS/NZS Standard Hydraulics Bench Tested.
- SGS Heavy Metal Leaching Analysis Approved.
